title: Clo Virtual Summit: Emea And North America 2025
description:
Missed the 2025 Virtual User Summit? Watch the full event right here!
Hear firsthand how CLO users across EMEA and North America, including creators Ana Córdoba, Erisson Sánchez, Trudy Gardner and Alex Woffenden, are transforming their careers with 3D fashion design. And discover the latest tools, certifications, and community initiatives driving the future of digital apparel creation.

00:00 Summit Kick-Off
00:02 Ana Córdoba – My Journey with CLO
00:14:40 Discovering CLO Academy
00:28:15 CONNECT and our Community
00:32:38 EU Rising Talent 2025
00:37:27 Erisson Sánchez - From Beginner to Creator with CLO
00:43:54 CLO Roadmap & Key Features
00:49:35 CLO Verified
00:53:37 Trudy Gardner - Design Thoughtfully with 3D Workflows
01:09:23 Alex Woffenden - My Journey with CLO so far
01:18:59 Inside Jinny
01:27:43 Every Cloud has a Silver Lining
01:38:39 That's a Wrap

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-

---
